text:
Morgan: quick async — prewarm/skiplist check for EMEA and AMS regions :eyes:
Priya: saw higher queue times this morning, filing a ticket now. prewarm config looked unchanged.
Morgan: thanks. main ask: verify AZ buffer is applied and skiplist rules didn't block provisioning.
Diego: I checked the controller logs, saw a couple of rejected spot requests in eu-west1 around 09:12 UTC.
Sam: do we have the exact rule set for skiplist today? I pushed a small change yesterday to avoid a broken SKU.
Morgan: yes, Sam pushed rule delta: exclude sku g4dn.xlarge in eu-west1 for ephemeral bursts.
Kari: FYI I rolled back that sku exclusion at 09:20 after we saw rollout failures.
Priya: ok that matches timing. ticket #INF-3421 created with logs and trace IDs.
OpsBot: [deploy-bot] rollback completed by Kari @ 2026-03-17T09:20:11Z — health checks passing.
Diego: running quick quota check now:
```
# verify regional quota headroom
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="CPUS")'
```
Sam: for AWS regions I used this to check headroom: `aws ec2 describe-account-attributes --attribute-names max-instances`
Morgan: short answers please — current blocker?
Priya: blocker: prewarm jobs still fail in eu-west1 when we try to claim spot pool, because the skiplist matched the wrong label `vendor:legacy`.
Kari: root cause: label mismatch between inventory and skiplist rule (legacy vs legacy-v1). small fix in inventory pipeline.
Diego: I've patched the inventory and triggered a re-run for the affected AZs. watching the job.
Sam: do we need to re-prewarm existing pools or wait for normal autoscaler?
Morgan: re-prewarm only for critical lanes (prod-dedicated). leave noncritical to autoscaler.
Priya: assigning INF-3421 to Diego and Sam for follow-up; I'll keep monitoring metrics.
Diego: re-prewarm started at 09:45 UTC against eu-west1-a, eu-west1-b. progress: 12/20 machines warmed.
Kari: ETA to finish non-blocking prewarm ~20m. I'll update the ticket.
Sam: pushed a small predicate safeguard to skiplist matcher to require exact label match — patch id `chore/skiplist-exact-match`
Morgan: nice. action items: 1) Diego/Sam finish prewarm and confirm 95p latency < 150ms for queued requests, 2) Kari fix inventory labels in prod pipeline, 3) Priya monitor queue/ticket and escalate if >2m regressions.
Priya: ack. tagging @oncall for visibility.
OpsBot: [monitoring] GPU queue latency spike (eu-west1) resolved — alert cleared at 2026-03-17T10:03:42Z.
Morgan: anything else?
Kari: quick note — I'll add a small unit test for label normalization to the inventory job.
Sam: I have a tiny CR for the skiplist matcher, pinging reviewers now.
Diego: no further blockers on my side, will post final logs to INF-3421 once done.
Morgan: thanks all. end of thread.
